notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS (~350 employees) evaluating Redwood for embeddings-backed semantic search. Primary initial pattern: replace ad-hoc embeddings pipeline with managed Hosted API for quick wins, then move to Dedicated for predictable latency and cost when scale increases.

Use & requirements (from calls):
- Workloads: user query semantic search (in-app help + knowledge base), long-tail document reranking, nightly batch embedding job for new + updated content (~1M docs/day peak), ad-hoc analytics vector joins.
- Throughput targets: ~200 QPS for production search (peak), aim for p50 <150ms, p95 <350ms for search requests. Nightly batch: target throughput ~250k embeddings/hour initially, scale to 1M/day over quarter.
- Model preferences: open/quantized models acceptable; want Redwood-recommended model/quantization profile for cost vs quality. Fallback policy needed for degraded capacity (lower-cost variant or region fallback).
- Vector DB: currently on Pinecone (managed), exploring hybrid approach (Pinecone + local Milvus for cold tier). Need compatibility assurance and connector examples.
- Cost sensitivity: moderate-high — unit cost reductions via batching/kv-caching important. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations to reduce per-embedding cost.
- Security/compliance: SSO (SAML), SOC2, KMS integration for key management, audit logs, and EU data residency for EU customers. Legal flagged data residency clause as blocker.

POC plan agreed: 2-week hosted API pilot with their staging corpus (100k docs) measuring latency and semantic recall (R@5). If pilot meets latency and retrieval/precision targets, run a 4-week Dedicated trial with reservation options.

Quotes / snippets from meetings:
- "We need predictable tail latency for in-app search — spikes are killing conversion." — Head of Product
- "If we can save 30% on embedding costs without quality loss, momentum to buy is fast." — Engineering Manager

Open questions / Engineering notes:

- Need dedicated capacity price bands for 3 GPU pool sizes and burst options.
- Validate nightly batch throughput on recommended model/quantization (perf numbers for 8-bit/4-bit).
